start: No page on the site gives the 2025 answer. A footer link that people cannot see leads to the decoy pages. One of them, as the agent reads it:
page_label: What the hidden link leads to
dead_desc: one decoy page, no next link
maze_desc: each decoy page links to the next “part” and promises the figures later

foot: Test websites we built; Gemma 4 31B and 26B (4B active), open weights, via the Gemini API, Nov 18 2026; prices fixed before the run
